note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated Indian customs shipping-bill records with B/L numbers, HS codes and destinations (Canada 07108090; Japan 20029000) as recent as 2026-02-28, out of Nhava Sheva (INNSA1). Note the declared HS set (071080; 071290; 090412; 090421 — dried vegetables, spices, tea/coffee husks) only partially matches observed records: 07108090 matches 071080, but the Japan shipments are 20029000 (tomato paste/preparations), which is outside the declared set — HS should be corrected to include 2002. Domestic supply evidence: none found in accessible sources; recorded as unknown, not as 'conditionally accepted'. The address on the customs record (Foods Inns Building, Sion-Trombay Road, Punjabwadi) is Mumbai, Maharashtra, which conflicts with the claimed state Karnataka — worth flagging, though the company is a known Karnataka-linked food processor; not resolvable from shipment data alone. No rejection grounds: entity clearly exists and is actively shipping.
